note: 1 unit = the stock's normal daily range (1 × daily ATR). Open trades close by 3:55 PM ET. Neither is a proven edge: both failed their backtest gates and live in the Graveyard; #1 made 8 trades today, #2 made 25.

setups.title: Gap-Down Bounce Rejection Short (5% gap)
lines: Gapped down 5%+ at the open, no earnings within 4 days, ≥ $1M traded a day
A 5-minute bar went above VWAP between 9:35 and 10:30; now a bounce bar reaches VWAP (or the 9:30–10:00 high) and closes in the lower half of its range
Stop at the 9:30–10:30 high; no target, hold to 3:55 PM

setups.title: Opening-Range Low Sweep Reversal
lines: Price runs 0.15+ unit below the 9:30–10:00 low, then within 60 minutes a 15-minute bar closes back above the open of the bar that made the sweep
Stop 0.05 unit under the sweep low (skipped if more than 1 unit away), target 2.5× the risk, else out at 3:55 PM
